Hi Emily — great to meet you and the team earlier. Quick recap from our 30m: Stella Health is evaluating a VPC/on-prem deployment for inference (HIPAA scope) to support a patient-facing summarization feature. You shared estimated steady-state daily token volume of ~120M tokens/day with peak bursts up to ~250M, and an initial pilot target of 10M tokens/day during month 1.

To move toward pricing, can you confirm the following so we can produce an apples-to-apples quote: 
- Finalized environment count (dev/stage/prod): you mentioned 1 dev, 2 staging, 3 prod in the call — please confirm.
- Desired SLA/support tier: do you need 24/7 enterprise support or Standard business hours for pilot?
- Budget band for the first 12 months (monthly committed spend range).
- Any non-negotiable security requirements (e.g., on-prem HSM integration, specific retention windows).

Attached is a short worksheet with three sample licensing models (subscription per dedicated instance, capacity-based reserved tokens, and hybrid committed spend + overage) with illustrative unit economics for $/1M tokens at different commitment levels. High-level options we discussed: 
- Option A (Reserved GPU pools, annual commitment) — best unit economics for predictable throughput.
- Option B (Subscription per-instance with capped throughput) — simpler procurement, slightly higher $/1M.
- Option C (Pilot: monthly committed capacity + overage credits) — lowest up-front lock for month 1-3.

If you can reply with the environment count and budget band today, I’ll send a tailored quote and a one-page summary for procurement.

Best,

Scenario A — 12-month Reserved Capacity (recommended if you want predictable unit economics)
- Monthly committed: $58,000 / month
- Effective unit rate: $900 per 1M tokens (based on steady-state 150M/day normalized to monthly consumption)
- Overage: $1,350 per 1M tokens above committed threshold
- Support: Start with Standard during pilot; optional upgrade to Enterprise (24/7) at +$6,500/month on go-live
- Licensing: Per-cluster license covering 3 prod clusters + 2 staging + 1 dev (includes KV cache and prefix caching features)

Scenario B — Pilot Monthly Commitment (3-month pilot, lower lock)
- Month 1 committed: $22,000 (10M/day baseline + buffer)
- Month 2–3 ramp plan: $35,000 / month
- Effective unit rate during pilot: ~ $2,200 per 1M tokens (higher initially due to low commitment)
- Overage: $1,700 per 1M tokens
- Support: Standard included; Enterprise can be added mid-pilot

Notes / ask to Rishi: please confirm whether HSM/KMS integration carries any one-time engineering cost to enable in-customer region and whether audit log retention to 7 years requires additional storage pricing.

Thanks all — quick technical check. The topology (3 prod + 2 staging + 1 dev) is supported by our Dedicated offering. Notes: 
- HSM/KMS: We support customer-managed KMS; one-time integration work estimated at 40–80 engineer-hours depending on vendor (cloud-HSM vs on-prem HSM). Recommend adding a one-time implementation line item ($12k–$24k) to the SOW.
- Audit logs: 7-year retention will increase storage and index costs. Estimate additional $900–$1,500/month depending on log verbosity and compression. We can provide a sampling strategy to reduce cost.
- Performance: With optimized kernels and batching, 150M tokens/day steady-state is realistic on a 6-cluster setup of A100-class or equivalent; we will baseline in a bench run.
- Pilot recommendation: 3-month pilot with committed monthly spend (Marissa Scenario B) + optional 30% ramp credit for first month to give them buffer.

I'll draft the technical appendix and sizing assumptions for the quote. Alex — if Stella is comfortable with the numbers, we should offer the 3-month pilot commitment with a clear migration path to the 12-month reserved model.
